title: Classifying Changes in Amputee Gait following Physiotherapy Using Machine Learning and Continuous Inertial Sensor Signals
summary: A single thigh gyroscope with DTW/Euclidean distance and k-nearest-neighbour classification distinguished pre- and post-physiotherapy gait strides in five lower-limb amputee participants. This is an exploratory, participant-specific feasibility result; the stride-level split does not establish generalization to new people.
organization: University of Toronto; Holland Bloorview Kids Rehabilitation Hospital
